acceptance_predicates.description: Online benchmark execution requires an explicit live mode selection.
Selected/all agents and implemented workloads are admitted from the reviewed configuration.
Credential, model, provider, timeout, and transport failures remain typed and nonzero.
An explicitly live run never changes to mock or replay after failure.
Human-readable output is default and --json is stable, complete, and secret-free.

definition_of_done: Selected/all live runner matrix passes with credential-free negatives and credential-backed positive when supplied.
No-fallback and output contract tests pass.
Independent review and hosted checks pass.

outputs.description: Bounded live benchmark result and typed diagnostics.
Privacy-safe run identity and outcome receipt.

gates.description: Explicit live selected/all execution and typed failures pass.
Human-default and explicit JSON output remain stable and secret-free.
